quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D input RMB 41,565,949.69 (2.69% of revenue, down 26.92%), of which 39.78% capitalised; 317 R&D staff. The MD&A puts total R&D funding at RMB 11274 ten-thousand, up 22.92%. The report says high-specific-capacitance high-purity tantalum powder samples passed customer certification and are sold in volume, and its 5N5 ultra-high-purity tantalum and sputtering tantalum target blank technology for 300mm wafers won an industry science award; a research project on uniform fine-grain high-purity tantalum aims to push tantalum target volume production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: construction in progress rose to RMB 435,838,248.99 at end-2025 (from RMB 136,256,841.40). Major projects (budget; cumulative input vs budget): tantalum-niobium pyrometallurgy product line retrofit RMB 357,378,800.00, 66.35%; hydrometallurgy digital factory RMB 678,687,800.00, 17.36%; new 400-per-year niobium superconducting cavity smart line RMB 184,359,500.00, 40.87%; pyrometallurgy smelting line capacity expansion RMB 277,775,800.00, 11.67%; high-end tantalum-niobium products line RMB 281,190,000.00, 1.62%; high-purity tantalum powder pilot line RMB 21,000,000.00, 60.97%. In 2025 the pyrometallurgy casting line entered trial production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the raised-fund pyrometallurgy product line retrofit (84.75% invested) had its ready-for-use date extended to June 30, 2026. Smelting, new machining, analysis and aluminothermic reduction sections were in stable trial operation by December 2025, but the casting section's main tool, an imported German 1600KW vertical electron-beam melting furnace, arrived in September 2025, 10 months late, after its German export licence was delayed more than 6 months; the 63MN fast-forging press line was not yet usable because the supplier had not delivered its automated hot-forging 3D measurement system.
quarterly_data.figure: Ready-for-use date extended to June 30, 2026; 84.75% invested

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 business plan: 2026 revenue target RMB 20 hundred million. The company plans to hold and raise its share of the traditional tantalum powder and tantalum wire markets, expand superalloy, superconducting and defence-industry markets, speed up commercialisation of tantalum targets and superconducting niobium, and build a tantalum resource reserve mechanism. It flags risks of rising competition or shrinking downstream demand and of volatile, mostly imported ore raw materials.
